title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Women’s Rights Programme in Ethiopia, implemented by ActionAid in conjunction with 23 local women’s groups works with marginalised women and girls, including survivors of violence, and Menja ethnic minority, in Semen Bench and Shey Bench in South West Region . The programme aims to reduce gender-based violence by increasing womwn and girls' confidence and knowledge to know their rights and demand access to services and the courts; improve livelihoods and participate in decision making at the local and national level. The programme engages with men, boys, local leaders and government officials to take action in support of women’s rights. In addition, the programme strengthens the resilience of women and girls to climate change impacts by increasing their knowledge of adaptation practices and seeks progressive climate investment that support women and girls. . Objective applies principally to gender equality
